NO OTHER APPEARANCES ON THIS MATTER. THE COURT DID NOT RECEIVE COURTESY COPIES OF PLAINTIFF'S MOVING PAPERS PER LOCAL RULE 2.7(B) AND REQUIRED PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL TO PAY A $60 MOTION FILING FEE VIA E-FILING BY 4:00PM TODAY (11/28/23) IN LIEU OF FILING A NEW MOTION. THE COURT GRANTED THE MOTION CONDITIONAL UPON THE PAYMENT OF THE ABOVE $60 FILING FEE BY 4:00PM TODAY. THE TRIAL DATE OF 04/08/24 WILL BE CONTINUED TO 05/13/24 IN DEPT. 206 AT 9:30 AM PER STIPULATION. ALL DISCOVERY TO TRACK THE NEW TRIAL DATE. IF THE $60 FEE IS NOT PAID BY 4:00PM TODAY, THEN THE COURT WILL VACATE ITS RULING AND DENY THE MOTION, AND THE CURRENT TRIAL DATE OF APR-08-2024 AT 9:30AM IN DEPT. 206 WILL REMAIN. MS. FISCHER TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER CONSISTENT WITH THE COURT'S RULING, APPROVED AS TO FORM. UPON THE COURT'S APPROVAL & FILING OF THE ORDER, MS. FISCHER TO SERVE ORDER.
